answer.text: Approval of two-thirds of unit holders by value (up to 2 years; 5 years for AI-only funds)

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that a Category I/II close-ended AIF's tenure may be extended by up to 2 years with the approval of two-thirds of unit holders by value, and that schemes restricted to Accredited Investors only may extend by up to 5 years on the same basis. The Trap: Absent the requisite investor consent, or after the extended tenure has expired, the AIF is wound up as per the SEBI AIF Regulations. Note: Based on workbook pages 68, 72, 217, and 220 covering tenure extension and winding up.
